en.headline: Hill fire burns 30-metre line near Yuen Long Kam Sheung Road
en.dek: Firefighters and a Government Flying Service helicopter tackled a blaze near Cheung Ngau Shan and Jing Hang Shan from about 11am; no injuries were reported.
body: Firefighters responded to multiple reports at about 11am on Sunday of a hill fire near Kam Sheung Road in Yuen Long, close to Cheung Ngau Shan and Jing Hang Shan.
The fire line stretched about 30 metres. Fire crews attended the scene and the Government Flying Service deployed a helicopter to drop water bombs. No injuries were reported.
The Fire Services Department said it was investigating the cause of the blaze. The yellow fire danger warning remains in force, with the Observatory noting a high fire risk.
Members of the public are reminded to take extra care with fire and not to leave burning materials during outdoor activities.

zh.headline: 元朗錦上路附近山火火線約30米 直升機投水彈
zh.dek: 周日早上約11時，掌牛山及井坑山附近發生山火，消防及政府飛行服務隊直升機到場撲救，暫未有傷亡報告。
body: 消防處周日早上約11時接獲多宗報案，指元朗錦上路掌牛山及井坑山附近發生山火。
火線長約30米。消防人員到場撲救，政府飛行服務隊派出直升機投擲水彈。暫時未有傷亡報告。
消防處正調查山火原因。黃色火災危險警告仍然生效，天文台指火災危險性頗高。
市民進行戶外活動時應特別小心，切勿留下火種。
